newsitem.title: CHINA: HK's International Hope Ltd completes club loan.
newsitem.headline: HK's International Hope Ltd completes club loan.

text.p: International Hope Ltd has completed a HK$265 million term loan facility on a club basis with five banks, arranger and agent Sumitomo Bank said on Friday.
The borrower is a special-purpose vehicle of SIIC Estate (Holdings) Ltd.
The three-year loan is jointly and severally guaranteed by SIIC Estate (Holdings) Ltd and Shanghai Industrial Investment (Holdings) Co Ltd.
Arrangers are Sumitomo Bank, Development Bank of Singapore, Bank of East Asia, DG Bank's Hongkong branch and Malayan Banking Berhad's Hongkong branch.
Proceeds will be used for a real estate development project in Hong Kong.
